######## Ducaniel's Laboratory (country scope) ########

DA_DL_lab_tier_1 = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_DL_lab_tier_1_tt
		any_owned_province = {
			province_id = 2963
			has_great_project = {
				type = The_Dwarven_Laboratory
				tier = 1
			}
		}
	}
}
DA_DL_lab_tier_2 = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_DL_lab_tier_2_tt
		any_owned_province = {
			province_id = 2963
			has_great_project = {
				type = The_Dwarven_Laboratory
				tier = 2
			}
		}
	}
}
DA_DL_lab_tier_3 = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_DL_lab_tier_3_tt
		any_owned_province = {
			province_id = 2963
			has_great_project = {
				type = The_Dwarven_Laboratory
				tier = 3
			}
		}
	}
}
DA_DL_idle = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_DL_idle_tt
		NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_DL_research_on }
	}
}
DA_DL_can_research_Brain = {
	DA_DL_idle = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Brain.1 } }
		DA_DL_lab_tier_1 = yes
		treasury = 500
		DA_alchemy_reagents_total_required = { amount = 10 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Brain.2 } }
		DA_DL_lab_tier_2 = yes
		treasury = 1000
		DA_alchemy_reagents_total_required = { amount = 20 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Brain.3 } }
		DA_DL_lab_tier_3 = yes
		treasury = 1500
		DA_alchemy_reagents_total_required = { amount = 30 }
	}
	else = {
		custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = DA_DL_line_complete_tt
			always = no
		}
	}
}
DA_DL_can_research_Warrior = {
	DA_DL_idle = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Warrior.1 } }
		DA_DL_lab_tier_1 = yes
		treasury = 500
		DA_alchemy_reagents_total_required = { amount = 10 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Warrior.2 } }
		DA_DL_lab_tier_2 = yes
		treasury = 1000
		DA_alchemy_reagents_total_required = { amount = 20 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Warrior.3 } }
		DA_DL_lab_tier_3 = yes
		treasury = 1500
		DA_alchemy_reagents_total_required = { amount = 30 }
	}
	else = {
		custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = DA_DL_line_complete_tt
			always = no
		}
	}
}
DA_DL_can_research_Pheromones = {
	DA_DL_idle = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Pheromones.1 } }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Pheromones.3 } }
		DA_DL_lab_tier_3 = yes
		treasury = 1500
		DA_alchemy_reagents_total_required = { amount = 30 }
	}
	else = {
		custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = DA_DL_line_complete_tt
			always = no
		}
	}
}
DA_DL_can_research_Calculator = {
	DA_DL_idle = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Calculator.1 } }
		DA_DL_lab_tier_1 = yes
		treasury = 500
		DA_alchemy_reagents_total_required = { amount = 10 }

DA_DL_capstone_ready = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_DL_capstone_ready_tt
		calc_true_if = {
			amount = 4
			has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Brain.3
			has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Warrior.3
			has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Pheromones.3
			has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Calculator.3
			has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Perception.3
			has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Stone.3
			has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Voice.3
		}
	}
}
DA_DL_can_research_Damestear = {
	DA_DL_idle = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Damestear }
		custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = DA_DL_line_complete_tt
			always = no
		}
	}
	else = {
		DA_DL_lab_tier_3 = yes
		DA_DL_capstone_ready = yes
		treasury = 3000
		DA_alchemy_reagents_total_required = { amount = 50 }
	}
}
